datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on October 02, 2022
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of October 02, 2022, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20221002]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite imagery from SAOCOM was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to delineate actual flood extent across the Philippines following typhoon impacts on October 2, 2022. The resulting flood map represents observed inundation boundaries derived from remote sensing data, enabling assessment of affected areas and disaster impact on infrastructure and agriculture.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite imagery-based flood extent mapping for the Philippines. Provides observed spatial delineation of inundated areas from tropical cyclone-induced flooding.
